# vp-vscode-template

Develop VS Code extensions using the Vite+ toolchain.

## Usage

1. Create a new repository from this template
   - using the [web interface](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/creating-and-managing-repositories/creating-a-repository-from-a-template)
   - using Github CLI

     ```
     gh repo create <new-repo-name> --template "edmccard/vp-vscode-template" --public
     ```
2. Clone the repository and run `vp install`.
3. Develop your extension normally (`F5` to debug, etc.) using `vp` instead of `npm`.
